messages:
emma.ops: Heads-up — starting the service-x deploy window now. Pin = v2.14.2-hotfix. Canary 10% for 15m, then 50%/100% if green. Release notes: https://wiki.redwood/rel/service-x/v2.14.2-hotfix :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started by @emma.ops — id=deploy-20260320-01
Command: ```deploy service-x --image=sha:abc123 --pin=v2.14.2-hotfix --canary=10% --timeout=15m```

jon.release: Copying backout/runbook links into thread: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/backout-service-x and https://wiki.redwood/ops/escape-hatch. TL;DR abort triggers: p95 latency > 220ms OR error rate > 1.0% over 5m.

lee.platform: Adding the Grafana panels to watch: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc/service-x. Watch these queries: p95_latency_ms, error_rate_5m, instance_mem_rss. Quick snippet for p95: `alias(percentile(response_time_ms,95),"p95")`

sara-sre: Oncall checklist if we abort: 1) `/deploy abort deploy-20260320-01` 2) pin traffic to `v2.14.1` (previous): `trafficctl route set service-x --version=v2.14.1` 3) disable canary routing for new image 4) run smoke tests `./smoke/service-x.sh` 5) open incident with template `inc create service-x-backout` 6) preserve logs and heapdumps.

emma.ops: Noted. Oncall @sara-sre will be standby for the canary window + 30m. If abort happens, jon, please coordinate changelog + comms.

deploy-bot: canary health update (5m): errors=0.4%, p95=180ms, instances healthy=12/12. :white_check_mark:

lee.platform: Also watch cache-miss ratio — last time that tripped the latency. Query: `sum(cache_misses)/sum(cache_hits+cache_misses)`

jon.release: Decision guidance for rapid ops: if it's data corruption or schema mismatch => immediate backout. If soft regressions (latency/memory) and traceable to new crates => consider pin + scale while we hotfix. Keep comms line: `#inc-service-x` open.

emma.ops: Adding emergency rollback commands to pinned runbook now and attaching link in ticket. Small reminder — keep the deploy id handy: `deploy-20260320-01`.

deploy-bot: canary health update (12m): errors=0.9%, p95=205ms, instances healthy=12/12 — approaching thresholds.

sara-sre: I have logs tailing: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=service-x --since=15m | grep ERROR | tail -n 50` — nothing catastrophic so far. If errors cross 1% OR p95 >220ms for two consecutive 5m windows, I'll execute abort.

jon.release: I'll prepare release-note rollback blurb and a short statement for #customers if we end up rolling back. Keep me looped. :thumbsup:

emma.ops: Thanks team — bring up any red flags. If abort happens, follow the runbook links jon posted and add the deploy id to the incident.

deploy-bot: canary health update (18m): errors=1.2%, p95=235ms — abort threshold breached.

sara-sre: Aborting now. `/deploy abort deploy-20260320-01`

deploy-bot: abort acknowledged. Started rollback to v2.14.1. Tracking: rollback-20260320-01.

emma.ops: Confirm rollback in progress. notif to #customers drafted by jon.

jon.release: Sending customer note and updating release page with rollback reason (increased error rate, p95 breach).

lee.platform: Post-rollout checks: confirm 5xx back to baseline, p95 back under 200ms, and no new alerts for 30m.

sara-sre: Smoke tests pass on v2.14.1 and monitoring stabilizing. Closing incident if stable for 30m.

emma.ops: Great job. Will follow up with RCA and a proposed mitigation (cache warm-up + tighter mem limits) tomorrow. :coffee:
